candidate.answerReason: For a random draw, the color counts 5 > 3 > 2 give the likelihood order red > white > yellow.

methods.label: Order the color counts
methods.explanation: The numbers of the three types of balls are 5, 3, and 2, respectively. The more balls of a type there are, the more likely that type is to be drawn, so red ball＞white ball＞yellow ball.
methods.levelReason: Uses qualitative likelihood ordering and comparison of small whole-number counts.
